name: Repository Branch Status Panel
purpose: Shows local branch, remote branch, main branch, sync, and working tree readiness for repository collaboration.
accessibility: Expose branch status, local branch, remote branch, main branch, sync status, working tree status, branch counts, decision, summary, evidence, blockers, and next workflow as visible text.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate branch readiness.
Keep branch labels and status details readable so operators can understand collaboration readiness before pull request work.
